stock.description: As an investment holding company, Super Hi International Holding Ltd. manages Haidilao-branded Chinese restaurants across a global network, including significant operations in Asia and North America. In addition to its restaurant operations, the company provides food delivery services and markets a range of hot pot seasonings and other food ingredients. Super Hi International Holding Ltd. was founded in 2022 and maintains its principal office in Singapore.
